$comment: The master bot mapping (added 2026-08-10). This is the ONLY place that says which physical Telegram bots exist, what kind each is, and which token/script runs it. telegram/config/tenants.json answers a DIFFERENT question -- 'what does this faculty teach' (content_scope/exam_content) -- and knows nothing about how many bot processes serve that content. One tenant can map to N bots here (e.g. capranav: one 'study' bot + one 'exam' bot) or just one 'unified' bot (e.g. csarunchouhan). Adding a bot for an already-onboarded faculty is a pure config change here -- no code, no changes to tenants.json. See bots.README.md for the full field contract and telegram/tools/manage_bots.py (the process manager) which reads this file to know what to start/stop.

bots.notes: Account-scoped, not content-scoped -- tenant_id is null on purpose, this bot has no relationship to any faculty's content_scope. Not yet refactored onto the BOT_ID/tenants.json pattern (its own token/DB resolution is untouched, still self-contained) -- listed here only so the process manager and heartbeat/dashboard can manage and see it alongside every other bot.

Same tenant (capranav) as capranav-study above, different bot/token/script -- this pairing is the whole point of this file existing separately from tenants.json. Token added to telegram/.env -- ready to launch via BOT_ID=capranav-exam.

Added 2026-08-11, Phase 4 foundation tier (Flask migration + sidebar shell + single-admin login + Bot Status/Restart + Bot Logs). Not a Telegram bot -- bot_token_env is null, it never talks to Telegram. Runs on port 8788 (ADMIN_PORTAL_PORT env var to override) ALONGSIDE the existing 1lavya-dashboard (8787), not replacing it yet -- see telegram/admin_portal/README.md for the migration plan. Added 2026-08-11 (Phase 3 of the roadmap). Not a Telegram bot with its own token -- bot_token_env is null on purpose, see leaderboard_broadcaster.py; each individual leaderboard in telegram/config/leaderboards.json specifies its OWN broadcast_bot_token_env (the bot that actually posts to that leaderboard's channels). Deliberately 'inactive' until at least one leaderboard in leaderboards.json is flipped to 'active' with real channel chat_ids -- starting it before then is harmless (it just finds nothing to broadcast every check) but pointless.

Flipped to 'inactive' specifically to prevent a real double-long-poll risk: this entry and Main1lavyaAIAgents/examstudyhub/config/bots.json's own 'coceducation' entry both reference the SAME live bot token (SALES_AGENT_COCEDUCATION_BOT_TOKEN) -- if this repo's manage_bots.py ever ran this entry while the Main1lavyaAIAgents copy is live, both processes would call Telegram's getUpdates for one token at once, which Telegram rejects with a 409 Conflict on the second connection (exactly the incident class the migration's own history already hit once, see Main1lavyaAIAgents's FIRST_PROMPT.md). Do not flip this back to 'active' -- the live process for this bot now starts only from Main1lavyaAIAgents/examstudyhub, via its own bots.json entry. DUAL PURPOSE, confirmed intentional by Pranav 2026-08-26: this SAME bot/token currently also serves as the public demo for the separate 'Faculty Search' cross-institute comparator product -- @Official1LavyaFacultySearchBot is shown to prospective institute clients as a demo of what a dedicated white-labelled bot looks like; once an institute actually signs up, they get their OWN separate token/bot, not this shared one.
